types.label: Experiments
types.blurb: Packets that test something we don't know yet. Each says what to watch for.

experiments.name: E907 · three colours? (red/green/blue)
experiments.watch: E907 has dual's 00 22 0F header plus a third colour. Watch where each colour lands.

experiments.name: E907 · Flipper sample #1
experiments.watch: Captured by someone else, purpose unknown. Midnight blue ×2 + purple.

experiments.name: E907 · Flipper sample #2
experiments.watch: Like #1 with blue instead of midnight blue.

experiments.name: Random colour on every LED
experiments.watch: Palette 0x1F on all five. Same random colour, or one each?

experiments.name: 'Unique' colour (0x1E)
experiments.watch: The colour your show's Repeating Fade used. Nobody knows what it is.

experiments.name: Channel 3 (E3) red
experiments.watch: Same red as a normal preset but on channel 3. Does the band answer every channel?

experiments.name: Always-on red (timing 8F)
experiments.watch: Bit 7 of the timing byte. Does it stay lit until another command?

experiments.name: 46-second red (timing 4F)
experiments.watch: Bit 6 = ×3.1 s multiplier, 15 × 3.1 ≈ 46 s. Time it.

experiments.name: Dual, park flags (4x)
experiments.watch: Red centre, blue corners, colour bytes flagged like real park duals.

experiments.name: Dual, builder flags (8x)
experiments.watch: Same colours, flagged like the app's Dual builder. Any difference from 4x?

experiments.name: Buzz, other encoding (5B)
experiments.watch: Red with the tail byte read the Flipper way (pattern in the high nibble).

experiments.name: Candles, mode 2B
experiments.watch: Your Oct 3 candles with mode byte 2A → 2B.

experiments.name: Candles, mode 03
experiments.watch: Mode byte 2A → 03. 02 is centre pulse; is 03 something else?

experiments.name: Twinkle, slow mode (0B)
experiments.watch: Your Oct 3 twinkle with 02 → 0B near the end: slow twinkle per the listener.

experiments.name: Unseen length E90A
experiments.watch: An E9 length nobody has captured, six colour bytes. Probably ignored.

experiments.name: Pink/cyan anim, 2nd pair changed
experiments.watch: Your most-played pattern with bytes 07 05 → 15 19. Does a second colour change?

experiments.name: 'RRC' ping (CC03 132000)
experiments.watch: A ping variant from the Flipper list. No light expected — watch for anything.
